execution.progress: Prepare/build take 4 stationary paid rounds; ignition 8; feed/extinguish 1. repeat counts completed operations. Escrow survives global pauses; cancellation releases surviving materials once. Spent ignition tinder, kit durability and effort never return.

abilities.costs: prepare: target owned branch and materials [{target,quantity:1}], 4 rounds at 1 energy, produces one equal-mass friction kit with 10 attempts. build: x,y and explicit materials totaling stone4+bark2+vine1; no target, 4 rounds at 1.5 energy, center within existing 0.65 surface interaction reach, radius0.45 plus0.25 clearance excludes solids/water/actors/roofs. feed: target hearth and explicit owned branch/bark/dry-grass/wood materials; exact positive tenths, capacity8 mass, 1 round0.5 energy. ignite: target hearth only, owned usable kit, loaded dry grass0.5+branch0.5, fuel moisture<=0.35, transmitted rain<=0.15, effective wind<=0.65, 8 stationary rounds1.5 energy; first stroke spends one kit attempt and0.1 tinder. extinguish: target only, 1 round0.5 energy.
abilities.effects: Shared persistent unlit hearth, cover condition80 loses0.25 per rainy round; rain transmission0.2+0.8*(1-condition/80), covered wind0.75. Real fuel moisture gains0.08*rain or dries0.01*(1+wind); lit fuel dries0.08 first. Up to1 actual fuel energy per round scaled by dryness; at most3 ember rounds, rain>0.6 extinguishes. Heat0.6*burnFraction*max(0,1-distance/2)*(1-0.5*wind), walls block, overheat remains. Real residue and released input mass tracked. Three stationary healthy fed rest/wait rounds with measured reduced cold qualify shared thermal-refuge; ongoing qualification maintains the same capped source by0.025/round, otherwise decays0.003. No healing, food, mastery, install reward or free fuel. Cover is not a room; smoke is cosmetic open-air evidence.

abilities.name: Process willow material
abilities.function: Separate real willow shoots into panels and bast; twist owned bast into usable binding.

execution.progress: Strip takes four stationary rounds, twist three; repeat counts completed transformations. Global pauses preserve escrow. Cancellation releases the actual unprocessed bundle or bast once; never restores standing stock or spent effort. An owned cancelled bundle can restart the full four-round process.

abilities.costs: Strip: a reachable visible willow with at least1 actual stock, or one owned unprocessed willow-shoot-bundle;4 stationary rounds2 energy each. Twist: one owned willow-bast;3 stationary rounds1 energy each. Source access uses surface interaction0.65, excludes trunk overlap and blocked reach. Materials remain carried escrow; failure, movement, changed action, lost reach/visibility or death cancels. Paid effort is never refunded.
abilities.effects: One1.2-mass willow stock unit becomes2 willow-bark panels(0.6 mass),1 willow-bast(0.5) and1 offcut(0.1). One bast becomes one0.5-mass binding cord. Panels and cord qualify for existing bark/vine recipe slots at unchanged quantities/mass, retain willow provenance and moisture; neither creates nutrition, warmth or mastery. At least3 paid healthy fed attentive rounds and successful usable output may qualify the performer for transient willow engagement1 for6 rounds/cooldown12 across both modes. Actual qualifying rounds settle a maintained component0.025 each only on successful completion; otherwise it decays0.003. Max of components capped1. Cancelled work never rewards.

abilities.name: Build rain canopy
abilities.function: Build a persistent open roof that intercepts rain and gradually dries actual mantle instances.

execution.progress: Six stationary paid rounds at1.5 energy. Exact escrow is retained through a matching plan continuation or global pause; change, lost access, invalidation or death releases surviving inputs once without effort refunds.

abilities.costs: Four branch, six bark-compatible panels, two binding units in explicit owned unreserved exact-tenth material entries. Clear2x2 footprint and four solid0.08-radius posts; front-edge surface reach within0.65; six stationary rounds1.5 energy each.
abilities.effects: Roof condition120 loses0.5*ambientRain each round; transmission0.1+0.9*(1-condition/120). Only whole-body covered geometry protects. Effective rain<=0.15 dries actual mantles0.02/round; otherwise wets0.10*effectiveRain. No heat, wind reduction, insulation, nutrition, food preservation or rest bonus. Drying can improve the existing mantle cooling reduction. Shared thermal-refuge requires three actual fed healthy stationary rest/wait rounds with measured dryness-dependent relief; existing cap1/cooldown12, no construction reward. Posts and mass persist after covering failure.

satisfaction.name: Nature appreciation
satisfaction.rationale: Actual sustained perception of wildlife provides personal sensory engagement; no proposal, study or partial sample qualifies.

satisfaction.name: Cautious food relief
satisfaction.rationale: Modest relief follows personally experienced nourishment from completed monitored exposure without adverse or confounding evidence. Examination, labels and absence of evidence do not certify safety or earn reward.

satisfaction.name: Thermal refuge
satisfaction.rationale: Three consecutive stationary resting/waiting rounds with measured avoided cold loss and lower cold discomfort, without starvation or health loss. Ownership, construction, application and study alone do not qualify.

satisfaction.name: Willow tactile engagement
satisfaction.rationale: Actual uninterrupted fed healthy tactile processing with useful output; pending-round credit settles only on completion so cancelled work cannot earn satisfaction. Both modes share one capped transient/maintained source.
